acceptance: An official TPC-H SF 1 run on DuckDB records two runs and reports the lower QphH
The corpus rule derives the same class and lane as for one run, and the snapshot check passes with no diff
The TPC-H official twin test asserts two runs
context: New departure found by the validation plan; owner decision 6 of 2026-11-25. Feature batch: official-sequence.
description:
## Problem
TPC-H 5.1.1.3 to 5.1.1.5 and 5.3.2 require two performance runs (each a power test and a throughput test) and report the run with the lower QphH. Official TPC-H runs one.

## Change
In official mode: Run 1 and Run 2, each power then throughput with seeds per crr-o3; record both runs; report the lower QphH as the run's metric; record the run structure so readers can tell.

## Decision gates
- If the corpus rule's facts cannot represent two runs without a new stored class value, stop and report the shape before changing the rule.

## Guardrails (apply to every step of this plan)
- Fix the root cause for every platform and benchmark. No rule, check, exception, label or test may name a platform or a version matrix; only the pvm items may name Polars, and only to run and stage that run's files.
- Never edit a stored result file. Stored outcomes change only through the rule; any change shows in the committed snapshot diff (scripts/corpus_compliance_snapshot.py) and is explained per bundle in the pull request body.
- No new stored class value. No reader decides anything from benchmark.compliance_class, conformance_class or summary.tpc_metrics.suppressed.
- One implementation per concept: reuse existing helpers; make duplicate-check-delta stays at +0; no second copy of the rule, the roll-up, the row decision or the qualification comparator.
- No explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check). User-facing changes add a changelog.d fragment; never edit CHANGELOG.md.
- Heavy work only through make heavy-run, after make heavy-status, with command, maximum run time and log path announced first. No live cloud runs. Never touch the lock, set BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK, BENCHBOX_HEAVY_ADMIT=force or BENCHBOX_HEAVY_WATCHDOG=off.
- Work in a linked worktree on the step's feature batch. Each batch is one pull request; run the local review before opening it; fix hosted-review findings; never post a stand-in or adjudication.
- Paths and line numbers were read on 2026-11-25 at the corpus rule head; re-read before editing and report drift instead of guessing.
- At a decision gate, follow the recorded owner decision. If its stop condition is met, stop and report to the owner; never substitute a different decision.
- Owner decisions: crr-00-corpus-rule-remediation-plan context, entries of 2026-11-22, 2026-11-24 and 2026-11-25. Design: the spec-faithful validation plan summarized in crr-00 (qualification test, integrity checks, official-mode sequence).
